title: Return Policy - Electronics
text:
This policy covers TVs and headphones bought from our store, whether you ordered online or bought in person. TVs and headphones can be sent back within 30 days of the day you received them, for a full refund or an exchange. The time limit counts from the day the item reached you, or from the day a TV was delivered to your home, not from the day you placed the order.

What to send back

A TV must come back with its stand or feet, the remote control, the power cable, the screws and any wall-mount parts that came with it. Headphones must come back with their charging case if they have one, the cable, the spare ear tips and the carry pouch. Please use the original carton for a TV if you still have it, because a screen is easily damaged in transit. For hygiene reasons, headphones that show signs of heavy use, such as worn or torn ear cushions or residue on the ear tips, are refused and sent back to you, so wipe them clean and pack them in their case before you send them. A TV with a cracked or scratched screen cannot be accepted.

How to start a return

To start a return, sign in to your account, go to your order history and choose the item. Headphones travel with the prepaid label we email you, and you can drop the parcel at any shipping point listed on the label. Large TVs are collected from your home: once you start the return, we contact you to arrange a pickup time, and the driver brings packing material if you no longer have the carton. You can also bring either item to the service desk in one of our stores, where a team member checks it with you. Unplug the TV and coil its cables before the driver arrives, so that the pickup is quick.

Your refund

When the item has reached us and passed its check, the refund goes back to the payment method you used. Most banks show it within a few business days. Gift card payments are refunded to a gift card, and a payment that was split across several methods is refunded in the same split. If a TV was delivered and set up by our team, the delivery and setup service is not refunded. We email you as soon as the refund has been sent.

Items we cannot take back

Mounting work done by an outside installer, cables that were cut to length, and apps or films bought through the TV cannot be sent back. A TV that was mounted on a wall and shows damage from the mounting is not accepted, and neither are headphones whose cable or headband has been cut or bent out of shape. Items damaged by a power surge or by being dropped are not accepted either. Headphones bought in the same order as a TV can still be sent back on their own.

Exchanges

You can exchange a TV for a different screen size, or headphones for another colour, within the same time limit. The exchange follows the same steps as a return. If the replacement costs more you pay the difference, and if it costs less we refund the difference to the payment method you used. For a large TV, the driver who collects the first set can bring the replacement on the same visit.
